RESEARCH_ONLY_LOCAL_BEST_IN_TESTED_POOL (two genuine admissible swaps, +Arcane Signet -Mox Amber and +Bitterblossom -Windfall; the five-swap owner-presentation floor is not met, so NOT owner-presentable). Arcane Signet: the Pass C requested test; bounded seeded goldfish (seed 27, 40000 games per cell) raises mean turn-4 mana sources 3.138 -> 3.193 and P(UU) under our own Contamination 0.038 -> 0.053; Mox Amber is live given deployed only 0.051/0.086/0.173/0.274 on turns 1-4 (Karn alone makes it produce nothing); EDHREC partner cEDH 79/81 vs Amber 18/81. Bitterblossom: a commander-independent token stream for Tevesh's +1, Contamination upkeep, Skullclamp, Phyrexian Tower, Culling the Weak and Beseech bargain; P(token engine online by turn 4) 0.1532 (Tevesh only, baseline) -> 0.2309, under Contamination 0.1187 -> 0.2019. Windfall refills opponents unless Narset or Notion Thief is out and is in no Spellbook combo here (adoption caveat: partner cEDH 53/81, mostly turbo lists). Neither cut is an owner addition or explicit keep. Spellbook 6 -> 6; lands 26 unchanged; Game Changers 22 unchanged. Serialized two commanders first, case-insensitive alphabetical, terminal newline.

REJECT (Pass C requested comparison; two-swap with Bitterblossom). Talisman of Indulgence equals Arcane Signet on raw mana (turn-4 mean 3.193) but makes only C/B/R and pings; P(U) by turn 4 under Contamination 0.272 vs Signet 0.330 (baseline 0.279). Dominated by Arcane Signet. Spellbook 6 -> 6.

REJECT (Pass C competing cut). Overburden is explicitly retained by the owner on 2026-10-14; the evidence for Signet is against Amber specifically (Amber's low live rate), so cutting the owner keep is not clearly better. Spellbook 6 -> 6.
RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (one-swap subset, staged). The Pass C mana swap alone, if the owner declines Bitterblossom. Spellbook 6 -> 6.

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (staged alternative cut for the Bitterblossom add). Keeps Windfall (higher partner cEDH adoption) and cuts Cyclonic Rift (Game Changer, 22 -> 21; overload costs seven under our own Orbs). Not preferred: Rift is the deck's main mass answer to opposing boards under stax. Spellbook 6 -> 6.

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (staged alternative cut). Magus of the Moon is a redundant, fragile Moon creature (deep review) and a nontoken creature that bounces our own land under Overburden; the deck keeps Blood Moon and Back to Basics. Not preferred over cutting Windfall because Magus is the third land-lock piece. Spellbook 6 -> 6.

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE_NOT_COUNTED (three-swap staged). Opposition is an asymmetric Thrull/Faerie lock that taps opponents' remaining untapped land under Winter Orb and is anti-synergistic with Static Orb's two-permanent untap cap, but measured deployability is far worse: P(seen and castable) by turn 4 0.0329 vs Static Orb 0.0599 with no lock, 0.0034 vs 0.0584 under our own Contamination. Not clearly better. Spellbook 6 -> 6.

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE_NOT_COUNTED (three-swap staged). Same Opposition add, keeping Static Orb and cutting Magus of the Moon; the UU-under-own-lock problem remains and Opposition/Static Orb still conflict. Owner decision only. Spellbook 6 -> 6.

REJECT (three-swap). Frozen Aether is four mana, does not touch permanents already in play, and does not stop instant-speed combo; absent from every EDHREC page for this pair or Tevesh. Spellbook 6 -> 6.

REJECT (three-swap). Strip Mine is colourless and loses its ability under our own Blood Moon / Magus; Gemstone Caverns is any-colour with a luck counter about three games in four (partner cEDH 73/81). Spellbook 6 -> 6.
